items.title: Pharma Stocks Have Rallied. 2 Stocks to Avoid—and 2 to Buy.
items.summary: The  home to some large pharma companies and many smaller biotechs, have risen over 6% this week.  The main catalyst was that  Moderna  and  Merck  announced successful trial data for a melanoma vaccine that reduces the risk patients will experience recurrence.  “The read-through [from Merck and Moderna] to the others is probably indicative of a broader tailwind of pharma taking some strong actions to improve their long-term growth profiles,” says Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Carter Gould.

items.title: Eli Lilly Is In A Race with Novo Nordisk But Its Stock Is The Clear Winner
items.summary: Eli Lilly stock broke out of a flat base and reached a record high. Its Mounjaro drug sales surged 91% in the second quarter.

items.title: These 7 Stocks Are Analyst Favorites For Magnificent Earnings Growth; Eli Lilly Tops Buy Point
items.summary: As the stock market rebounds, it's important to watch the stocks that are holding up and are most loved by equity analysts. items.title: Is Eli Lilly (LLY) Undervalued On UK Foundayo Approval?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) is back in focus after the UK's Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency approved Foundayo, a once daily oral GLP-1 drug for weight management and type 2 diabetes. See our latest analysis for Eli Lilly. The Foundayo approval arrives during a strong run for Eli Lilly’s stock, with a 30 day share price return of 11.63% and a year to date share price return of 18.51%. Over the longer term, total shareholder returns of 82.64% over one year and 136.19% over three years...
